name: a dot globe counts live clicks
looks: A short link label sits above a glowing globe built from a scatter of small dots, a thin bright line running down through its centre to a big number that keeps climbing at speed, digits blurring as they roll.
build: The globe is a dot field (kit.rng-seeded points on a sphere, projected); the centre number rolls up under a vertical blur whose strength follows its own speed, tied to the same clock as the dot field's gentle rotation.
sound: A soft granular patter under the globe and a rising tone under the rolling number.
prompt: Build a glowing globe out of a scatter of small dots, with a bright line running down to a big number that rolls upward fast enough to blur its digits, to show one quantity climbing live under a short label.
